item.title: Mike Duggan ‘studying’ Trump school choice program for Michigan
item.description: In his bid for Michigan governor, independent Mike Duggan is not ruling out a new federal ‘Education Freedom Tax Credit’ program that unions argue amounts to a ‘voucher scheme.’

item.title: Gretchen Whitmer: Raise $800M for Medicaid by taxing nicotine, gambling, ads
item.description: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer pitches $800M in new taxes as a way to ensure the ‘sustainability’ of Medicaid in Michigan. Republicans say no way.

item.title: Opinion | If Michigan wants to lead again, it must reinvest in education’s basics
item.description: In business, you don’t fix problems by cutting corners and hoping for the best. If we’re serious about making Michigan #1 in education, then we need to be honest about priorities.

item.title: Gretchen Whitmer pitches $88B budget. What it means for Michiganders, schools
item.description: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer’s office unveiled her $88B budget proposal on Wednesday, calling for more spending on literacy and education with some tax hikes and some tax breaks.

item.title: Mundy Township megasite won’t house data center; demolitions continue
item.description: Months after Sandisk withdrew plans for a semiconductor plant near Flint Bishop Airport, demolitions continue to assemble the megasite — even without a clear occupant.

item.title: The energy boom is coming for Great Lakes water. Is Michigan ready?
item.description: How the region powers its growth will determine the future of the Great Lakes.

item.title: Michigan experts warn: Your child’s new friend may be an AI companion
item.description: Teens are increasingly using AI companions — not just for schoolwork, but for companionship and social interaction. Experts warn that heavy use may be linked to increased loneliness and emotional dependence.

item.title: Report: Michigan-Canada bridge delay could cost up to $7M per week
item.description: Delayed opening of the Gordie Howe International Bridge would cost Canadian and US taxpayers, while indirectly affecting the auto industry, according to an analysis that follows President Trump’s threat to block the crossing.

item.title: Trump cancels federal climate regulations. Here’s what it means for Michigan
item.description: Despite scientific consensus on the harms posed by climate change, the administration no longer views greenhouse gases as harmful to public health. That sets the stage to stop regulating them.

item.title: Supporters tout benefits of kratom, but will it stall Michigan drug fight?
item.description: A kratom derivative known as 7-OH targets the same receptors as painkillers and opioids. Experts say the products, sold in colorful packages, especially endanger children and people battling addiction.
